/-- Power of 2 increment: 2^(n+1) = 2 * 2^n -/

lemma pow_two_succ (n : ℕ) :

/-- Split sum over Icc 0 (k+1) into Icc 0 k plus last element -/

lemma sum_split_last (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 (k + 1), f j) = (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, f j) + f (k + 1) := by rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega)]

/-- Pascal's rule valid for j >= 1 -/

lemma pascal_identity_positive (k j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
  Nat.choose ((k + 1) + j) j = Nat.choose (k + j) j + Nat.choose (k + j) (j - 1) := by cases j with
  | zero => contradiction
  | succ j' =>
  calc
    Nat.choose ((k + 1) + (j' + 1)) (j' + 1) 
      = Nat.choose (k + j' + 2) (j' + 1) := by ring
    _ = Nat.choose (k + j' + 1) j' + Nat.choose (k + j' + 1) (j' + 1) := by rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ (k + j' + 1) j']
    _ = Nat.choose (k + j' + 1) (j' + 1) + Nat.choose (k + j' + 1) j' := by rw [add_comm]

/-- Binomial symmetry: n choose k = n choose (n - k) when k <= n -/

lemma choose_symm (n k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ n) :
  Nat.choose n k = Nat.choose n (n - k) := by simp_all

/-- Shift index in sum: ∑_{j=0}^k f(j) = ∑_{i=1}^{k+1} f(i-1) -/

lemma sum_shift_index (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
  (∑ j ∈ Finset.Icc 0 k, f j) = (∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (k + 1), f (i - 1)) := by {
  apply Finset.sum_bij' (fun j _ => j + 1) (fun i _ => i - 1) <;>
  simp_all [Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.lt_succ_iff] <;>
  omega
  }

/-- Power relation: 4 * 4^k = 4^(k+1) -/

lemma four_pow_succ (k : ℕ) :
  4 * 4 ^ k = 4 ^ (k + 1) := by omega
